Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this — Contoso Healthcare is preparing for a regulatory review focused on cross-border data flows and third-party controls. Before our legal team signs the DPA, we need the following evidence to complete our file: 

- A data flow map showing where patient-identifiable data (PII/PHI) traverses Redwood systems and any subprocessors outside the EEA.
- GDPR Art. 28/30 operational records (processing activities relevant to our account).
- A current list of subprocessors with locations and contractual dates.
- Confirmation of whether Redwood can support a DPIA session (short walkthrough with examples) and provide a point of contact for follow-up questions.
- Clarification on audit options: remote secure evidence upload vs. a limited on-site read-only inspection (we understand constraints).

We need this material by Aug 31 to meet our internal review timeline. If any of this requires an NDA or an additional agreement before sharing, please flag it.

Would you be able to call out what you can provide by EOD tomorrow and any items that would need redaction?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Marta

Contoso Healthcare

- Data flow diagram (redacted for other customers) — format: draw.io export + PDF.

- On-site or privileged access: we require a short access agreement and a named scope (dates, team, objectives).
